cohort: 3247 healthy, term, exclusively breastfed newborns born between January 1, 2011 and December 31, 2014 at a single Turkish hospital.
finding: Infants born via cesarean section had significantly higher weight loss percentages at 24, 48, 72, and 84 hours of life compared to those born vaginally.
